title: 'Fast walkers' code word for UFOs in space

tellings.quote: US Space Force, uh, Northcom, Space, um, NORAD, they actually have a term for UFOs in space, which it's, uh, fast walkers.

plain: The US military commands that watch the skies and space over North America, the Space Force, NORTHCOM (the command that defends the US homeland) and NORAD, are said to have their own term for UFOs moving in space: "fast walkers." The researcher Maaneli Derakhshani says so to Michels, without naming where he learned it. If true, it would mean the military tracks such objects often enough to need a word for them.
